findings.evidence: grep of `ofBijective (Algebra.ofId` in TauCeti/ returns Splitting.lean:140, 191, 199 (all three paired with `Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.1`) plus Wedderburn.lean:118; Mathlib has no packaged AlgEquiv for this — `Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/FreeAndStrongRankCondition.lean:298) only yields bijectivity.
findings.fix: Introduce one `noncomputable def` (e.g. `Algebra.algEquivBaseFieldOfFinrankEqOne (h : Module.finrank K D = 1) : D ≃ₐ[K] K`) with its own `_symm_apply` simp lemma, and define all three sites through it — `baseFieldAlgEquivOfIsBrauerTrivial` becomes it applied to `(isBrauerTrivial_iff_finrank_eq_one K D).1 h`, and the `(rfl)` at line 207 becomes a consequence of the shared lemma rather than a fresh unfolding of the definition. `baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinite` (Wedderburn.lean:117) can then be expressed through the same def via `finrank_eq_one_of_finite`.
findings.issue: The term `(AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId K D) (Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.1 _)).symm` is repeated verbatim at lines 140-141 (inside `Algebra.isSplittingField_self_of_isBrauerTrivial`), 191-192 (reverse direction of `isBrauerTrivial_iff_finrank_eq_one`) and 199-201 (`baseFieldAlgEquivOfIsBrauerTrivial`), differing only in the source of the `finrank = 1` hypothesis. The reusable fact `finrank K D = 1 → D ≃ₐ[K] K` is thereby hidden inside three proofs, and the two `@[simp]` lemmas at lines 205 and 211 duplicate `baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinite_symm_apply` / `algebraMap_baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinite` (Wedderburn.lean:122-129) statement for statement.

summary: Proofs are robust and readable, with no undocumented defeq manipulation or brittle rewrite chains. One reusable construction — the algebra isomorphism D ≃ₐ[K] K obtained from finrank K D = 1 — is written out inline three times in Splitting.lean instead of being named once.
